# StartupCookie
> AI-native content & GTM agency for B2B SaaS startups. One person, maximum six clients at a time, programs from $5,000/mo.

StartupCookie runs product marketing and product-led growth (PLG) content, thought leadership, founder LinkedIn, AEO (AI search optimization), video content, and custom GTM/content agents for seed-to-Series-B B2B SaaS companies. Founder Barbara Jovanovic's appearance on HubSpot's Marketing Against the Grain is the most-watched episode in the show's history (151k+ views).
